description: Official Norges Bank exchange rates against the Norwegian krone: the latest business day, one day (a weekend or holiday gives the prior business day) or a daily series up to 366 days, for chosen currencies or all of them. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

currencies.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 codes, e.g. USD,EUR. Default: every currency Norges Bank publishes.

date.description: One day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the latest business day. Not together with from and to.

from.description: Start of a period (YYYY-MM-DD). Needs to; the period is at most 366 days.

name: get_exchange_rates
title: Exchange rates against NOK
